description: Agent Tool-Call Validator & Repairer API: Validate and auto-repair broken LLM tool-call arguments against your JSON Schema. (Endpoint: POST /v1/tool-call-validator)

apply_defaults.description: Populate missing properties that declare a `default` value in the JSON Schema.

coerce_types.description: Coerce safe LLM type mismatches ('10' -> 10, 'true' -> true, stringified JSON arrays/objects, enum casing).

fuzzy_match_tool_name.description: Match tool names across snake_case, camelCase, and kebab-case differences.

strip_unknown_properties.description: Remove hallucinated keys not declared in `properties` when `additionalProperties: false`.

tool_call.description: Raw LLM tool call (OpenAI function/tool_call, Anthropic tool_use, Gemini functionCall, MCP tools/call, or raw string).

tools.description: List of allowed tool definitions with their JSON Schemas.

name: tinplate_tool_call_validator
